'''Yed'ore'shenai''', [[Core name/Legends|core name]] '''Doresh''', was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] stationed at the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Dorn Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War|renewed war]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[3642 BBY]], he informed an Imperial individual that [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] were training [[Republic trooper|Republic soldiers]] in their cold weather ambush tactics. He then asked the Imperial to disrupt the Republic's training camp and destroy the Talz and Republic forces that were camped there.
